name: LEGO Demo Assembly
description: A small five-step practice build. Use compatible bricks you have; colors are suggestions, not a required set.

steps.title: Build the base
steps.instruction: Place two blue 2×4 bricks side by side, with their long edges touching and studs facing up. They form a 4×4 base.

steps.title: Connect the foundation
steps.instruction: Place two red 2×4 bricks on top, rotated 90° relative to the base. Each brick should span the seam so the base is connected.

steps.title: Add the left support
steps.instruction: Place a yellow 2×2 brick at the back-left corner of the top layer. Leave the front two rows of studs exposed.

steps.title: Add the right support
steps.instruction: Place a second yellow 2×2 brick at the back-right corner, beside the left support. Both supports should be level.

steps.title: Bridge the supports
steps.instruction: Place a green 2×4 brick across both yellow supports. Press gently into place and manually check that all layers are connected.
